Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that contracts are excluded from Part 2 PCR 2015 if they are subject to procurement procedures established by international agreements or organisations, or if they are fully or primarily financed by international organisations or institutions.
heading_path: Public contracts awarded, and design contests organised, pursuant to international rules
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation also addresses the specific procedure to be followed for the award of contracts involving defence or security aspects which are awarded according to international rules.
